summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Algonquin Power & Utilities Corp. reporting the results of its annual meeting of shareholders held on June 29, 2026, and the election of nine director nominees. The filing includes standard voting results on director elections, auditor reappointment, share unit plan amendment, and executive compensation advisory vote. There are no special-situation elements such as a merger, tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, or management change. This is a routine current report of a foreign private issuer, not a special situation filing.
